what_changed: DesiRNAGenerator._run no longer scrapes trajectory_files/*_traj.csv, *_replicas.csv and *_random.csv as candidates. Nothing else in the product changed. Same seed (0), same budget ladder (standard, then --rescue at best_effort on the failures), same 57 modal targets, same panel, same judge.
why_rerun: trajectory_contamination_score.py measured the fix on the POOL: median 0.792 -> 0.822, and the gap to novelty-matched peers -0.155 -> -0.123. The product does not ship the pool, it ships one panel-selected sequence, so the effect on DELIVERY is unmeasured. That is the only untested link.

baseline_to_beat.source: leaderboard_ours.json + leaderboard_score.json, same seed and flags, contaminated adapter

F1.stat: per-target crossed-pair F1, fixed minus contaminated, paired over the 57 targets, Wilcoxon one-sided greater
F1.note: a target delivered by one arm and not the other scores 0.0 in the arm that failed it, so coverage changes are not silently dropped

F2.stat: count of targets returning a sequence
F2.pass: descriptive; reported either way, no threshold

F3.stat: L1 median diff against the per-target median of all real designs excluding Struct2SeQ-SHAPE, and the count of methods we beat
F3.pass: descriptive. A placement change is NOT claimed as a capability gain unless F1 also passes, because the leaderboard metric saturates and rank is a coarse readout of it

declared_in_advance: The judge (RibonanzaNet crossed-pair F1) is the same quantity on both arms and neither arm was selected on it, so this is not the max-vs-median tautology that killed the pool-rerank headline on 2026-08-08. The selector in both arms is the thermodynamic panel, which is independent of the judge.

Expected effect is SMALL. The pool-level gain was +0.008 median (33/57, p=3.3e-05) because contamination is only 8.3% of the pool at the 60 s tier. The panel already rejects most trajectory states, so most of the pool-level gain may already be absorbed by selection and the delivered gain could be zero.

A null result here is a real result and will be reported as one. It would mean the contamination fix is a correctness fix rather than a quality fix -- we stop shipping states the solver rejected, without shipping better ones.
The three methods we beat are the older physics designers. If that set does not change, say so plainly rather than looking for a rank that moved.
cost: $0 API. Local solver, local panel, local CPU judge.
